clinical_intent: Calculate the volume of the high-risk clinical target volume (HR-CTV) for a cervical cancer patient based on the following MRI measurements: the tumor extends 3.5 cm craniocaudally, 4.2 cm transversely, and 3.8 cm anteroposteriorly. Using an ellipsoidal volume approximation, calculate the HR-CTV volume and compare it to the typical HR-CTV volumes reported in the EMBRACE studies. Is this volume consistent with a Stage IIB cervical cancer?
